Great food, great service, low price
Dec 2023 • Family
Best Indian food I’ve had in my 6 months of travelling south east Asia so far. Proper authentic Punjabi food, perfectly made. Being from the midlands in England we are spoilt for choice with good Indian restaurants back home, and the fact that this is up there with one of the best I’ve ever eaten at says a lot. They have an extensive menu with ample choice, as well as having a vast variety of vegetarian options to choose from also. We ordered 6 different dishes and can honestly say we all enjoyed every single one. The service was fantastic, staff going above and beyond to ensure we had what we needed and we were well looked after. Highly recommend
